headline: Short-period SSW slop with onshore morning — junky and small.
today: Around 2ft at 3-5s on a fair angle, and the morning onshore keeps it textured. Wind backs to cross-on later, marginally better but still weak. Log it if you're bored, otherwise pass.

daysToWatch.note: South onshore builds to 16mph through the day — bumpy and getting worse, not a target.
The standout: up toward 6ft with cross-off morning wind going light in the afternoon. Fair angle and short period, but the size and clean wind make it the day to clear your schedule. Shortboard.
Holdover 2-plus feet with offshore dawn wind — a clean early session before the E cross fills in.
